title: TRTD: Temporal Riemannian Trust Deformation for Continuous Zero-Trust Verification under Federated Network Drift
description: TRTD is a geometry-aware framework for federated intrusion detection and continuous Zero-Trust verification under concept drift. Network behaviour is represented as trajectories on the manifold of symmetric positive-definite (SPD) covariance states. Local traffic changes are encoded as tangent-space deformations and transported between successive reference states using affine-invariant parallel transport. TRTD combines geometric deviation with a temporal deformation residual to derive a drift-adaptive trust score and Zero-Trust policy boundary. This repository contains the experimental notebook, generated figures, and result tables for the TRTD framework.
